description: This file defines a Scala object 'V2ScanPartitioningAndOrdering' that extends Rule for LogicalPlan transformations in Apache Spark. It extracts and converts V2 data source partitioning and ordering information into Catalyst representations, annotating logical plans accordingly.

classes.name: V2ScanPartitioningAndOrdering
classes.description: A singleton object extending Rule for transforming LogicalPlans by extracting and converting V2 data source partitioning and ordering info.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the rule to a LogicalPlan, sequentially transforming it with partitioning and ordering extraction.

methods.name: partitioning
methods.description: Transforms the LogicalPlan to extract and convert V2 partitioning info into Catalyst format.

methods.name: ordering
methods.description: Transforms the LogicalPlan to extract and convert V2 ordering info into Catalyst format.
